name: SAUNABOX SmartSteam XL
description: SaunaBox SmartSteam XL: Your Wellness Oasis, Wherever Life Takes You. The SaunaBox XL is your personal wellness retreat, reimagined. Designed for portability, convenience, and comfort, this 2-person steam sauna transforms any space into a rejuvenating sanctuary. With effortless setup and cutting-edge features, it's relaxation, wherever and whenever you need it. The SaunaBox XL heats up to a soothing 130°F , delivering the therapeutic benefits of a traditional sauna in a compact, user-friendly design. Its high-humidity environment enhances the sauna experience, mimicking the effects of a dry sauna at much higher temperatures. Adjust your heat and duration settings with ease using the SmartSteam™ Pro Heating Unit and remote control, customizing every session to your needs. Every detail of the SaunaBox XL is thoughtfully engineered to deliver premium quality. The fully insulated, easy pop-up tent enhances portability, while its durable fiberglass frame and SweatLock Floor Mat guarantee comfort and longevity. Designed to set up in under 1 minute, it's as easy to transport as it is to enjoy. Product Specifications: Heat Levels: 1-15 Time Settings: 0-60 minutes Control: SmartSteam Unit & Bluetooth App SmartSteam Capacity: 3.6L Voltage: 110V Wattage: 1600 Watts 50/60Hz Warranty: 1-Year Warranty Size: 56in W x 53in H x 49in L
